review_context: Second runnable L&E replay family reviewed-learning coverage and raw replay input red-team.
finding_title: Raw replay source inputs need source-token binding when case IDs are placeholders.
finding_summary: A raw budget actuals source or carrier rejection source bundle can be schema-valid and still belong to the wrong synthetic L&E replay family because these source templates intentionally use placeholder budget and preflight IDs. The input-pack audit needs deterministic source-token binding against the concrete legal budget anchor before marking raw source inputs ready.
observable_context: The wage/hour replay family now has committed synthetic raw budget actuals and carrier rejection source inputs.
Direct builders bind or validate concrete IDs, but the input-pack audit is the earlier QA gate that decides whether local source refs are ready for replay.
The raw actuals fixtures use __BUDGET_PROPOSAL_ID__, and carrier source bundles use filled-by-test budget and preflight placeholders, so placeholder IDs are not same-case evidence.
The scout agent identified that actuals_source_id, source_ref, bundle_id, and run_id carry stable synthetic source markers that can be compared to the legal budget anchor token.
observable_decision_logic: Placeholder IDs must stay allowed for builder templates but must not count as proof that the raw source belongs to the selected replay case.
The legal budget proposal is the concrete local anchor because it carries budget_proposal_id, preflight_packet_id, and matter_family.
The input-pack audit should reject raw source inputs whose synthetic source markers do not contain the same case token as the legal budget anchor.
This remains a Python/Pydantic oracle because the authority-sensitive semantics are still evolving; Rust can later implement bulk scanning after these tests define the behavior.
solution_path: Derive a local source-case token from concrete legal budget and preflight IDs in the replay slot.
Allow placeholder IDs in raw source templates but reject concrete mismatches when raw source IDs are present.
Validate budget_actuals_source.json against actuals_source_id and source_ref markers.
Validate carrier_rejection_capture_source_bundle.json against bundle_id and run_id markers.
Add negative tests that point the wage/hour replay slot to discrimination actuals and carrier source inputs and expect the audit to block.
applies_when: A replay input-pack manifest declares raw source templates with placeholder case IDs.
A raw source artifact has stable synthetic source identifiers such as actuals_source_id, source_ref, bundle_id, or run_id.
A concrete legal budget proposal anchor is available for the same replay slot.
does_not_apply_when: A generated report already carries concrete budget_proposal_id and preflight_packet_id and can be checked directly.
A production Orchestrator owner supplies a stronger governed matter-linking contract.
A raw source input intentionally belongs to a documented aggregate cross-case replay contract.
danger_if_misapplied: If raw placeholder-bearing sources are accepted without source-token binding, QA can replay or learn from the wrong synthetic family while all individual JSON schemas still pass.
suggested_actions: DAD should classify placeholder-bound raw input mismatches separately from malformed JSON and generated-report wrong-case mismatches.
DAD should track which source markers are only local synthetic evidence and must not become canonical Semantic Substrate taxonomy.
Future Rust work should implement this only as a leaf checker after the Python tests remain the contract oracle.
reviewer_notes: This record contains synthetic fixture references only.
It records observable evidence, assumptions, decision logic, fix refs, and test refs without hidden chain-of-thought.
red_team_notes: Do not treat placeholder IDs as observed case identity.
Do not let source-token matching become a production matter-linking substitute.
Do not treat local synthetic family tokens as promoted canonical matter taxonomy.
